title: docc compile output
description: What docc compile --format json prints: one object on one line. It is printed in every case; when the sources have errors of groups 1xx-2xx, or docc failed (exit code 2), tree and pages are empty and ok is false.

ok.description: No error diagnostics and not more warnings than maxWarnings (or --max-warnings): the exit code is 0.

shown.description: Always the number of diagnostics: compile lists them all.

failure.description: Why ok is false without errors: too many warnings.

diagnostics.description: As docc validate --format json reports them; a failure of docc itself is one diagnostic with code config, usage or error.

title.description: Title of the first page of the tree; empty when nothing was compiled.

lang.description: lang of docc.json: the language of fixed labels.

brand.description: branding of docc.json, null without it.

logo.description: The logo file as a data: URI.

tree.description: The document tree. With "tree": "folders" in docc.json it is the folders of src; otherwise pages nested by parent below the roots, then the pages without a parent.

pages.description: Every page a reader sees, in tree order; hidden documents and notes are left out.

code.description: DOCxxx, or config, usage, error for a failure.

file.description: Relative to the project root, with '/'.

title.description: Title of the folder's own page (the document named like the folder inside it), else the folder name.

id.description: Id of the folder's own page, when it has one.

children.description: Pages whose parent this is; absent when there are none and always in folder mode.

path.description: Source path relative to src, e.g. decisions/monolith.json.

title.description: With its number when numbering is on.

parent.description: Id of the parent page, null when there is none or it is hidden.

crumbs.description: Ids of the parent chain, outermost first.

props.description: One-line fields shown as a property list instead of sections (when a page has two or more).

h.description: HTML, without the paragraph around it.

sections.description: Field and $sections headings in page order. A section's heading stands before the first block whose sec is its id, after the blocks of the sections before it.

id.description: Anchor of the heading: what [[page#field]] links point at (#<page>--<id> in the HTML of blocks).

blocks.description: The text of the page in order: a string of an array of paragraphs, or a whole value (table, list, number).

p.description: JSON Pointer of the value in the source; empty for the footnotes of the page.

h.description: HTML. Links to pages are #<id>, to fields #<id>--<anchor>; images are data: URIs.

sec.description: Id of the section the block stands under; null above the first heading.

i.description: A form field, drawn in place of h.

comments.description: The readers' comments of the page ("$comments" of the source) in file order, without their email. A lost one is shown at the top of the page, the others under their block.

at.description: JSON Pointer of the block (p of a block or a prop); for an answer, the pointer of the form field.

quote.description: The text of the block when the comment was written.

fragment.description: The words the reader selected; absent for a comment on the whole block.

prefix.description: A few characters before the fragment, to tell one occurrence from another.

suffix.description: A few characters after the fragment.

text.description: The comment; absent for an answer.

input.description: An answer: the id of the form field.

answer.description: An answer: the text given, the option picked or the options ticked.

author.description: The name of the author; may be empty.

place.description: same: the block reads as quoted; changed: the block was edited since; lost: no block at at, the fragment is not in it, or the answered field is gone (DOC215).
